jei.innovativecontraptions.info.compact_: Crafting component for Reactor Coolant Injectors.
jei.innovativecontraptions.info.coolant_: Refills matching condensators in the reactor or reactor chamber behind it when they are more than %s%% used, using one refill block and %s EU each. Takes MV power on every face except the back.
jei.innovativecontraptions.info.lzh_cond: Soaks up heat and never releases it. Craft it with Redstone (%s each) or Lapis Lazuli (%s each), or let an LZH Coolant Injector refill it.
jei.innovativecontraptions.info.nuclear_: Runs while it gets a redstone signal. Every neutron pulse makes %s EU/t; fuel rods pulse themselves and their four neighbours, so touching rods make more power and more heat. Heat goes to neighbouring heat holders first and the rest into the hull. A hull over 40%% sets things on fire, over 50%% boils water, over 70%% irradiates, over 85%% turns blocks to lava, and at 100%% the reactor explodes. Reactor platings shrink the explosion.
jei.innovativecontraptions.info.reactor_: Opens a fluid reactor and gives hoppers its inventory.
Place against a Nuclear Reactor to add one column, up to %s chambers. Opens the reactor and passes on redstone, hopper items and EU (through cables).
Moves IC2 Coolant into and Hot Coolant out of a fluid reactor. Use a Fluid Ejector or Fluid Pulling Upgrade on it to fit it; use it with an empty hand to take the upgrade back.
A redstone signal here turns a fluid reactor on.

A complete 5x5x5 shell of Pressure Vessels, Access Hatches, Fluid Ports and Redstone Ports around a reactor with 6 chambers makes a fluid reactor: no EU, vented heat turns IC2 Coolant into Hot Coolant at %s HU per mB.
jei.innovativecontraptions.info.rsh_cond: Soaks up heat and never releases it. Craft it with Redstone to restore %s each, or let an RSH Coolant Injector refill it.

screen.innovativecontraptions.lamp.guide: Attach to a solid face or energy emitter. The back accepts up to tier-4 EU into a 5 EU network buffer. Lights whenever powered, consuming 0.25 EU/t; a redstone signal turns it off. Right-click to invert redstone behavior, or use a tier-1 supply battery to charge up to 10,000 EU at once. A full lamp toggles mode instead. Active contact burns hostile mobs for 10 seconds, or undead hostiles for 20 seconds.
screen.innovativecontraptions.pad.guide: Stand on the pad to charge armor, then main inventory items every two ticks. Each item can receive two packets per update, respecting its tier. Top rejects network input; the marked face outputs EU. Offhand items are not charged.
screen.innovativecontraptions.storage.gu: The marked face outputs EU; five other faces accept it. Top automation charges items, bottom discharges supply items. Charging respects item tier and transfer rate. Redstone supplies 800 EU, disposable batteries 1,200 EU, and energium dust 16,000 EU. Consumable fuel needs positive free space but adds its entire energy. Wrench rotation changes the output face. Drops retain 80% energy by default.
screen.innovativecontraptions.transforme: The marked face is the high side. Step down accepts one high packet and can output four low packets per tick. Step up collects low packets into one high packet. Automatic mode steps up when powered by redstone. Fixed modes ignore redstone.
